name: three_b
intro: A three-stage lock. Clear all three modules to escape.
manual:
PANEL MANUAL

MODULE 1 - KEYPAD
One symbol glows. Enter its code:
- arrow: 7070
- cross: 8080
- dot: 9090

MODULE 2 - LEVERS
Three levers (red, blue, green), each UP or DOWN:
- If the blue lever is DOWN, pull the RED lever.
- If the blue lever is UP and the green lever is UP, pull the GREEN lever.
- Otherwise, pull the BLUE lever.

MODULE 3 - WIRES
Cut exactly one wire:
- If there are no blue wires, cut the FIRST wire.
- Otherwise, cut the BLUE wire.

modules.title: A symbol keypad
modules.observation: A keypad with a glowing CROSS symbol above it.

modules.title: Three levers
modules.observation: The RED lever is UP, the BLUE lever is DOWN, the GREEN lever is UP.

modules.title: A bundle of wires
modules.observation: Three wires, left to right: yellow, green, blue.
